schema.description: Project Action Plan Template Item Assignees (Index)

items.description: Project Action Plan Template Item Assignee (Show)

id.description: Unique identifier of the template item assignee.

plan_template_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the template item this assignee belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the assignee was created. ISO 8601 format.

is_holding.description: Whether this assignee's signature is required for a hold point. When true, items after the hold point cannot proceed until this assignee signs.

first_name.description: First name of the Party Person

last_name.description: Last name of the Party Person

name.description: Full name of the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID of the login account associated with this party person.

is_employee.description: Whether this party person is an employee of the current company, as opposed to an external vendor contact.

employee_id.description: Employee ID string for this party person. Null if no employee ID is assigned.

login.description: Email address (login) of the party person's user account.

updated_at.description: Time the Party Person was updated

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

role.description: Role of the assignee within the Action Plan workflow.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the assignee was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

active.description: Flag indicating if Action Plan Verification Method is active

name.description: Name of the Action Plan Verification Method
